copy.headline: Musume restaurant reopens 3 years after hotel blast in downtown Fort Worth
copy.caption: Almost three years after an explosion ripped through the Sandman Signature Hotel in downtown Fort Worth, the hotel's restaurant, Musume , has reopened following a $4 million rebuild.
